strategy.offer: Integrated equipment, software, formwork, consulting, installation, maintenance, and retrofit services for setting up, automating, and operating factories producing prefabricated building components.
strategy.customers: Manufacturers of prefabricated building elements, construction groups, and investors needing efficient fixed or mobile production close to projects.
strategy.why_we_win: They expect to win through customer-centered, tailored systems that combine high quality, efficient processes, automation, and lifecycle support.
strategy.resources: Basis includes experienced engineering and planning, broad modular technology, continuous research, integrated manufacturing, and trained employees encouraged to take responsibility.
strategy.direction: Pursue sustainable, planned growth by developing new technologies and products, expanding automation, and preserving long-term independence through responsible operations.
